title: RAW UNREVIEWED: fixed measurement-reference roles restrict a later whole-context comparison
summary: Two already-priced measurement records of a bound patient may use different units or reference bases. A later comparison requires a common basis or a written already-priced conversion; a change in number alone cannot establish a material or state change.

design.mechanism: Measure the same paid patient, write a reference or unit change, then measure again. Each record retains value, unit, reference basis and measured patient. A comparison consumes compatible records or an explicit paid conversion. Observation does not silently produce a new material batch.
design.contrast: Measurement/report account versus an account that treats numeric difference as physical transformation or increased material.
design.prediction: Use immutable roles and grammar across two complete nominated contexts. A written basis change must affect comparison legality without selecting new unit/conversion meanings locally.
design.scope: No new numerical decipherment, control corpus, generic framework or hidden conversion.

required_falsifier: Reject if the complete fixed graph compares incompatible records without written conversion/common basis, changes the measured patient silently, or requires new local operator meanings to legalize the comparison.
exact_changed_research_decision: Require a paid measurement hypothesis to predict which later comparison is licensed across a written reference change, rather than infer an outcome from free numeric labels.
